references.text: Jesus emphasizes the importance of being awake and prepared, since one does not know when He will return.
Similar to the call to stay awake because the time of the Lord's coming is unknown.
Similar to Jesus' exhortation to be ready and watchful for the Lord's coming.
Jesus urges the disciples to stay awake and be alert, since one does not know when the time has come.
Paul reminds the Thessalonians that the day of the Lord will come like a thief and emphasizes the importance of being vigilant.
Calls for vigilance and self-control while waiting for the day of the Lord.
Jesus' warning to remember what they have received and heard, and to hold fast to it, for He will come like a thief.
Jesus says, 'See, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps their garments.'
